text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um, um, um, Trainer! Isn't this week's 
chapter of "Senkou Drive" just way too 
hype!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist's... Ritz's older brother 
was! That guy with the scar over his eye 
who showed up last week! Yeah, and the 
foreshadowing for the flashback arc too!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm just so hyped! Like, I knew 
for sure that you'd love this kind of 
development, Trainer! And then--!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Shall the two of us read it again together 
right now? I have so, so much I want to 
talk about! ...Hehehe♪
